verdict.rationale: Auth0's AI docs explicitly describe CIBA-based human-in-the-loop approval: agents can request approval for sensitive operations via push, SMS, or email even when the user isn't actively in the app, framed specifically as securing AI agent transactions with human-in-the-loop controls. This is directly first-party documented as part of the Auth0 for AI Agents offering. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the CIBA-for-agents flow in production and more implementation detail (e.g., SDK code samples) beyond marketing/docs summaries.
